report.summary: Patient P-D008 (41, Medicaid with transport benefit) reports driving an older running car; screener shows no transportation need. One upcoming appointment: primary care on 2026-10-22 at 16:00 at the Clinic (kept). Home tract 17031400800 is low-income with 45.7% of households lacking a vehicle, but the patient has personal transport. Eligible transport options identified: Medicaid Ride Line (Medicaid plan members; call number on card ≥2 business days ahead) and Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit certification, decisions up to 21 days). Senior Shuttle West is not eligible (age 60+; patient is 41). A medical ride request form is also available to check qualification, but requires patient identifiers and was not submitted.
